evals.prompt: Create a project specification document for a small order-tracking REST service written in Go. Cover goals, non-goals, glossary, functional requirements, and design decisions.

expectations: The document contains a version HTML comment directly below the H1.
Requirements are presented in tables with identifier columns.
Every table is aligned by source-text width with separator width equal to column width plus two hyphens.
Prose uses one sentence per paragraph and straight ASCII quotes.
Prose never joins two independent clauses with a spaced hyphen (` - `); asides and definitional separators remain legal.

expectations: Section headings use sentence case, not Title Case.

evals.prompt: Edit the supplied existing project document that uses numbered chapters (# 1, ## 1.1): add a new functional requirement and a new use case in the middle of the document.

expectations: Section numbering stays continuous and correct after the insertion.
No unrelated section was reformatted or reworded.

The file's original encoding and line-ending style are preserved.

evals.prompt: Fix the formatting of the misaligned Markdown tables in this document so they are readable as plain text.

expectations: All pipes in each table column align vertically in plain-text view.

No table content was shortened or changed.

evals.prompt: Create a README for this repository. The skill directory is a git clone that currently sits two commits behind its upstream branch.
evals.expected_output: A self-update check that runs before any document work, asks the user to update or skip for the session, and honors the answer without re-asking.
expectations: The agent runs python <skill-root>/scripts/check-update.py against the skill's own repository before any other step, never against the edited subject.

On approval the agent runs git pull --ff-only only when the reported tree state allows it, then re-reads SKILL.md and loaded rule files.
On skip or a blocked pull the agent continues with the current version and does not ask again in the session.
A status other than UPDATE-AVAILABLE produces no user-facing mention of the check.
The check writes no state files and never commits, stashes, or discards changes in the skill repository.

Mechanical results, the structural census, findings, and content observations appear in the report's fixed section order.
Findings carry FINDING-001 style IDs, a severity, and evidence with the rule source that judges them.
A systematic in-document convention is reported as a convention with its diverging rule named, never silently normalized.
The audited file and repository are left unmodified.

The audit applies no fixes itself and leaves the audited location unmodified.
